Name: Celebi Fairy Trinket
Author: alextofu
Description:
[center]﻿
The new trinkets that were added in the 1.6 update are lovely and I was in need of an adorable companion. This mod retextures the the fairy trinket into Celebi![/center][center][/center][center]﻿There are 2 config options for the normal and shiny variant, default is normal but you can change it through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ or manually.

[/center][size=4][b]Installation:[/b]
[/size]Download and unzip into your mods folder.

[size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b]
[/size]This mod affects the fairy trinket only, as long as two mods aren't overriding the same asset it should be compatible with everything.

[size=4][b]Credits:
[/b][/size]The lovely [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/79665293]Doragoun[/url] for helping with the base of the sprite.

As the sprite is already 16 pixels tall making variations of the animation would be difficult without losing it's likeness but I am open to it in the future. Also open to any other Pokemon-related ideas you might have, eventually I plan on retexturing all the trinkets into Poke-related assets.
